name: J M Sen Hall Durga Puja Mandap
address: J M Sen Hall, Rahmatganj, Chattogram, Bangladesh
description: The central city puja mandap of Chattogram, organised by the Chattogram Mahangar Puja Udjapan Parishad on the J M Sen Hall field in the Rahmatganj area. National media have described it as the city's central puja mandap, and music and cultural programmes are held here during the festival.

name: Hazari Lane Durga Puja
address: Rashik Hazari Lane, Chawkbazar, Chattogram, Bangladesh
description: One of the oldest Durga Puja mandaps in Chattogram; the committee marked the puja's 150th year in 2024. Besides Durga Puja it organises pujas of other deities through the year, and its evening arati with women's dhunuchi dance is a known attraction.

name: Panchbari Puja Udjapan Parishad
description: Traditional community puja on Banshal Road in the Patharghata area. A 2024 report said it marked its 74th year, with the theme 'destruction of demonic power' (অসুর শক্তির বিনাশ).

name: South Nalapara Sarbojanin Puja Parishad
address: South Nalapara Road, Sadarghat, Chattogram, Bangladesh
description: A widely attended sarbojanin puja of South Nalapara; the committee has organised theme-based mandaps for several years, including a presentation on small ethnic communities in 2022. In 2026 the mandap was decorated around the theme 'Para-Mahalla' (neighbourhood).

name: Gosaildanga Ekata Gosthi Sarbojanin Durgotsab
address: Field in front of Chittagong Stock Exchange, 1080 Sheikh Mujib Road, Gosaildanga, Agrabad, Chattogram, Bangladesh
description: Long-running sarbojanin durgotsab of the Gosaildanga area near Agrabad, which marked its 130th year in 2024, with the theme 'Durga in her own form' (দুর্গা স্ব-রূপা). The mandap is set up on a large open field in front of the Chittagong Stock Exchange building.

name: Gosaildanga Sarodiya Durgotsab Udjapan Parishad (Baroari Puja)
name_bn: গোসাইলডাঙ্গা শারদীয় দুর্গোৎসব উদযাপন পরিষদ (বারোয়ারি পূজা)
description: Baroari (community-subscription) Durga Puja of the Gosaildanga Bandar area, recorded as a puja place of worship in publicly available map data.

name: Shmashaneshwar Shiv Bigraha Mandir Puja (Shib Bari)
name_bn: শ্মশানেশ্বর শিব বিগ্রহ মন্দির পূজা উদযাপন কমিটি (শিববাড়ি)
address: Firingi Bazar (Shib Bari), Kotwali, Chattogram, Bangladesh
description: Puja of the Shmashaneshwar Shiv Bigraha Mandir, known locally as Shib Bari, in Firingi Bazar; in 2024 the committee observed the puja's 95th year, making it one of the older puja venues of the city.

name: Uttar Kattali Kalibari Sarbojanin Puja Mandap
name_bn: উত্তর কট্টলী কালীবাড়ি সার্বজনীন পূজা মণ্ডপ
description: Sarbojanin puja mandap at the Uttar Kattali Kalibari in the north-western part of Chattogram. For Durga Puja 2026 its theme is 'Obinnoshor' (Indestructible), as reported on 3 October 2026.

name: Prabartak Sangha Puja Mandap
address: Prabartak Sangha (Bangladesh), Prabartak Circle, Panchlaish, Chattogram, Bangladesh
description: Puja mandap on the premises of Prabartak Sangha (Bangladesh), a long-established humanitarian and educational institution at Prabartak Circle in Panchlaish. A newly constructed mandap was inaugurated here on 2 October 2026 ahead of Durga Puja 2026.

name: Enayet Bazar No. 1 Puja Mandap
description: Neighbourhood puja mandap on Enayet Bazar Road, recorded as a Hindu place of worship in publicly available map data. The Enayetbazar-Goalpara area is one of the city's traditional idol-making (pratimaloy) hubs in the run-up to Durga Puja.

name: Shyama Kali Bari Durga Mandir
address: New Shahid Lane, Akbarshah, Chattogram, Bangladesh
description: Hindu temple and mandir complex on New Shahid Lane in the Akbarshah area of Chattogram, recorded as a place of worship in publicly available map data.

name: Chittagong Port Puja Temple
address: Port Colony, Road No. 3, Chattogram, Bangladesh
description: Hindu temple in the Chittagong Port Colony area, recorded as a puja temple in publicly available map data.

name: Sri Sri Kaibalyadham Durga Puja
address: Sri Sri Kaibalyadham, near Colonel Hat, Pahartali, Chattogram, Bangladesh
description: Durga Puja of Sri Sri Kaibalyadham, the ashram established at Pahartali by Sri Sri Thakur Ramchandra Deb and inaugurated in 1930-31. According to the ashram's own history, Durga Puja with an idol of the goddess was first performed at the ashram in 1338 BS (1931).

name: Binayak Sangha Puja Udjapan Parishad, North Halishahar Acharyyapara

description: Neighbourhood Durga Puja committee of the Acharyyapara area in North Halishahar, Chattogram, which maintains an official Facebook page for its annual puja and puja-related events.

name: Kolagaon Nabarun Durga Mandir
description: Durga mandir at Kolagaon on the eastern side of the Karnaphuli, recorded as a place of worship in publicly available map data.

description: Village sarbojanin puja committee in Banigram of Banshkhali Upazila, Chattogram district, which runs an official Facebook page for its annual Durga Puja.

address: Madhyam Nalua, Satkania Upazila, Chattogram, Bangladesh

address: Saha Para, Dharmapur, Satkania Upazila, Chattogram, Bangladesh
